title: Machine Learning Fundamentals
description: Evaluate your understanding of gradient descent, loss functions, overfitting, clustering, and model validation.
seoTitle: Machine Learning Fundamentals Quiz – ML Algorithms & Metrics | AI Quiz Arena
seoDescription: 10-question Machine Learning challenge covering supervised vs unsupervised learning, gradient descent, overfitting, and precision/recall.

questions.question: What occurs when a machine learning model performs exceptionally well on training data but poorly on unseen test data?
questions.explanation: Overfitting happens when a model learns noise and specific idiosyncrasies of training samples rather than general patterns.

questions.question: Which optimization algorithm iteratively adjusts model parameters in the direction of the steepest descent of the loss function?
questions.explanation: Gradient Descent minimizes the loss function by computing gradients with respect to parameters and taking proportional negative steps.

questions.question: What type of machine learning uses unlabeled datasets to discover intrinsic groupings or structures?
questions.explanation: Unsupervised learning discovers hidden patterns, clusters, or representations in data without explicit ground-truth target labels.

questions.question: Which evaluation metric represents the ratio of True Positives to all samples predicted as positive (TP / (TP + FP))?
questions.explanation: Precision measures the accuracy of positive predictions: of all instances marked positive, what fraction were truly positive.

questions.question: What is the primary role of an activation function (e.g., ReLU, Sigmoid) in a neural network?
questions.explanation: Without non-linear activation functions, a multi-layer neural network would collapse mathematically into a single linear regression.

questions.question: What popular unsupervised clustering algorithm partitions n observations into k clusters based on nearest mean centroids?
questions.explanation: K-Means groups data into k distinct clusters by iteratively recomputing cluster centroids and assigning points to their nearest centroid.

questions.question: In classification problems, what diagram shows the counts of True Positives, False Positives, True Negatives, and False Negatives?
questions.explanation: A Confusion Matrix summarizes the prediction results of a classification algorithm across actual versus predicted categories.

questions.question: What regularization technique randomly deactivates a fraction of neurons during each forward/backward training pass?
questions.explanation: Dropout randomly zeroes out units during training to prevent co-adaptation of neurons and mitigate overfitting.

questions.question: What is the key algorithm used to calculate gradients of loss with respect to weights in multi-layer neural networks?
questions.explanation: Backpropagation applies the calculus chain rule recursively from the output layer backwards to compute gradient values efficiently.

questions.question: What does the 'F1 Score' measure in classification models?
options: Arithmetic mean of Precision and Loss
Harmonic mean of Precision and Recall
Geometric mean of Accuracy and AUC
Weighted sum of Sensitivity and Specificity
questions.explanation: The F1 Score is the harmonic mean of precision and recall: 2 * (Precision * Recall) / (Precision + Recall).
